text:
Olivia K: final preflight for Fri 13:00 UTC change window. We need pins, rollback decision, and the freeze timeline. Can everyone ack?
Sam R: ack. I have a request to bump dedicated capacity at T-30m — will schedule unless there are objections.
Mike O: ack. Runbook ready, smoke tests good locally. I need deploy-bot canary output and the exact commit we're pinning.
Tara P: ack. Release notes draft is in PR #482; no customer-facing breaking changes, but we should call out temporary rate-limit change.
Ben S: ack. Prepared rollback play: immediate traffic shift to model v2.3.0 and autoscale down on new pool. Thresholds: 5% error rate or latency > 2s p95 for 5m.
deploy-bot: ```
[deploy-bot] canary-check
canary-region: eu-west-1
canary-commit: abc123def
canary-health: PASS (latency p95 380ms, errors 0.6%)
pinned-branch: release/2026-03-20
pinned-assets: model-quant-v2.3.1
```
Olivia K: thanks. Sam, confirm the exact pin identifier we should put in the deploy manifest (need full artifact name).
Sam R: pin will be model-quant-v2.3.1+sha=abc123def. I'll add that to manifest and create the pin PR.
Mike O: I approve pin to v2.3.1 for eu/us/apac. I'll start the monitoring dashboard (latency, error-rate, tail-alloc). If anything spikes, I'll trigger the rollback plan.
Tara P: one more ask — add a short blurb in the release notes about the quiet window and customer-facing latency expectations. I can merge the note once pin PR is in.
Ben S: escalation path: paging @oncall-sre if errors > 10% for any 2m. Ops runbook updated: https://wiki/internal/runbooks/deploy-rollback (referenced).
Olivia K: decision log: pin model to model-quant-v2.3.1+sha=abc123def, bump capacity to +2 nodes at T-30m, freeze rules apply from 12:50 UTC (no non-critical merges).
Sam R: scheduled capacity bump at 12:30 UTC (automated job). Pin PR created: https://git/repo/pulls/513.
deploy-bot: ```
[deploy-bot] pin-apply
manifest: release-manifest-2026-03-20.yaml
applied-pins: model-quant-v2.3.1+sha=abc123def
status: OK
note: canary will be promoted if stable for 10min
```
Mike O: quick check — rollback contact list is current? Ben, you got the oncall rotation?
Ben S: yes. Oncall list synced, contact numbers in runbook updated. Also added a temporary metric alert with a 2m sensitivity on p95.
Olivia K: all approvals recorded. We'll enter freeze at 12:50 UTC — please refrain from any merges not explicitly marked emergency. If you're holding a hotfix, ping me with justification.
Tara P: merging release notes after pin PR is green.
Sam R: I'll monitor capacity and metrics during the window.
Mike O: standing by for rollback trigger. Good to go from my side.
Olivia K: thanks team — proceeding with the plan. Will post a final "freeze in effect" message at 12:50 UTC. :rocket:
